meaning: Proposed successor acceptance only; no key deletion, readback, account, provider, OAuth adapter or PLC migration result is asserted. Original44vectors remain frozen.

vectors.name: temporary-key-erased-after-readback
vectors.given: Destination-key web document is independently read back with exact DID/PDS/handle agreement
vectors.expected: Delete temporary private key and JWT and release signing handles before activation; retain public evidence only.

vectors.name: temporary-key-still-advertised
vectors.given: Readback still advertises temporary #atproto key after a staged account exists
vectors.expected: Stop; no activation, OAuth completion or app append. Repair the same binding only within the original window; erase custody on expiry.

vectors.name: temporary-key-custody-expires
vectors.given: Original setup deadline expires before destination binding can be confirmed
vectors.expected: Erase temporary key/token, report incomplete setup and last known public binding; no renewed key lifetime or automatic new account/DID.

vectors.name: temporary-key-exact-token
vectors.given: Fresh private setup key is ready immediately before intended import
vectors.expected: Mint one short-lived token only, exact issuer did:web:H, exact destination service audience and createAccount lxm; no method-less, other-audience or replacement token from this key.

vectors.name: expired-import-jwt-successor
vectors.given: Single import token expires with unresolved creation reply
vectors.expected: Reconcile the same recorded account through account management only within the original short custody window; no refreshed token. If unresolved when the window closes, stop and erase temporary custody; later recovery separately resolves uncertain allocation.

vectors.name: lost-creation-reply-within-window
vectors.given: createAccount reply is lost while original short custody window is open
vectors.expected: Identify same recorded DID/provider/account through private account management; do not allocate again. Once identified, rotate promptly, independently read back destination binding, delete temporary custody, then consider activation gates.

vectors.name: unavailable-old-pds-web-migration
vectors.given: Old PDS unavailable; operator retains web control and accepted app content/floors
vectors.expected: Pause app writes and use same just-in-time private key and single-token procedure for same DID at explicit destination; rotate promptly, read back and erase temporary custody, preserve/import prefix and reconcile exact pending writes before activation/app appends. Missing history never permits blank same-genesis recreation.

vectors.name: temporary-key-deletion-fails
vectors.given: Public destination readback succeeds but deleting private custody or closing signing handles fails
vectors.expected: Stop activation and app use; report safe incomplete phase, no successful handoff claim.

vectors.name: writer-preserves-owned-input
vectors.given: Owned A1 request boundary refuses deterministic URL/body/count input
vectors.expected: Writer preserves sanitized input category through real request adapter; no content_unavailable flattening, secret/SDK text leakage or unconditional write retry.

vectors.name: writer-preserves-unavailable
vectors.given: Owned A1 request boundary reports transient transport, dropped body or deadline
vectors.expected: Writer preserves sanitized content_unavailable category; no proven invalid action/empty repo/success claim. Native publisher reconciles uncertain conditional writes.

vectors.name: cooperative-plc-migration-successor
vectors.given: Destination recommendations omit independent recovery key; authorized PLC migration operation is being prepared
vectors.expected: Submitted operation explicitly retains independent recovery public key higher priority than PDS-controlled rotation keys; verify canonical full signed resulting PLC history, same app DID/prefix/floors and new binding before activation, reauthorization and resumed app writes.
vectors.supersedes: A2D1-31 on independent recovery priority and verification only

vectors.name: migration-loses-recovery-priority
vectors.given: Submitted/resulting PLC history omits independent recovery key or puts it below PDS-controlled rotation keys
vectors.expected: Stop migration completion; report unsatisfied independent-recovery condition. Recommendations/latest DID/setup metadata cannot prove priority or justify switching authority modes.
